text: {"features":[{"name":"Role motivation","description":"How clearly and compellingly the letter explains why the applicant wants this specific kind of work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in the position only in generic terms, with little indication of why this work matters to the applicant."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives a basic reason for applying, such as interest in security or backend work, but the rationale remains broad or interchangeable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a clear, role-relevant reason for applying and links it to prior interests or experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a convincing motivation centered on security automation and the team's mission, making the role feel like a deliberate next step."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys a distinctive, strongly felt motivation that tightly connects the applicant's career direction to the exact leverage and problems of this role."}]},{"name":"Role understanding","description":"How well the letter demonstrates understanding of the team's actual responsibilities and operating context.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Refers to the job in very broad terms and shows little understanding of the actual responsibilities beyond generic security software work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions one prominent responsibility from the posting but does not show how the pieces of the role fit together."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Reflects several responsibilities such as vulnerability handling, automation, AI agents, or backend systems in a way that matches the posting."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates a strong grasp of the role as building tools and infrastructure to scale security processes across the development lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows nuanced understanding of the role as safe, scalable security automation that assists developers, handles vulnerabilities, and amplifies scarce security expertise."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"How strongly the letter values shared infrastructure and cross-organizational impact rather than single-product feature work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses mainly on individual features or personal interest, with little sense of cross-organizational leverage or foundational impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or impact in passing, but not as a defining way of thinking about engineering work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses clear interest in foundational or cross-cutting systems that benefit many teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Emphasizes the multiplier effect of central tooling and frames past or desired work around organization-wide leverage."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently treats shared infrastructure and fleet-wide impact as the core appeal of the role and as a guiding principle in the applicant's work."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"How strongly the letter frames security engineering as helping other engineers through better tooling, defaults, and workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about how security tooling should help other engineers or presents security in mostly abstract terms."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies helpfulness to other teams but does not clearly discuss reducing friction or improving developer workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that security should assist developers or make secure behavior easier in practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes defaults, tooling, or workflow design that helps busy engineers do the secure thing without added burden."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes developer enablement a central theme, showing strong empathy for tool users and a clear philosophy of security as support rather than policing."}]},{"name":"Google tailoring","description":"How specifically the letter is adapted to Google and this team rather than being broadly reusable.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could be sent almost unchanged to many software roles, with little beyond the job title tying it to Google or this team."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Google or the team name, but the letter remains largely generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes one or two relevant Google-specific references such as scale, security culture, or the named team."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Tailors the case to multiple specific aspects of Google's environment or this team's charter in a natural way."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Feels unmistakably written for this role at Google, weaving company context and team-specific priorities into the argument throughout."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"How strong the letter's academic credential is for this role and how relevantly it is framed.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents only the minimum educational credential for the role, without connecting it to deeper technical preparation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a bachelor's degree and gives some indication of solid technical grounding beyond the bare minimum."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a master's degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a doctoral degree in computer science or a related technical field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents an advanced degree and explicitly uses it to reinforce technical depth directly relevant to the role."}]},{"name":"Software engineering experience","description":"How much relevant professional experience with testing, maintaining, and launching software products the letter presents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows the lightest relevant professional experience in this sample, typically around the minimum years and only a small number of launched services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows enough relevant experience to meet the role cleanly, but with moderate breadth across years or production systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level experience with several years of work and multiple tested, maintained, and launched services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong experience across longer tenure or broader repeated service ownership, suggesting well-developed production judgment."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows the strongest combination of tenure and repeated product lifecycle ownership, with many launched and maintained services over time."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Go as a primary language for relevant production work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly as one language among several, with little indication it is a main tool or area of ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows regular Go use, but mostly as part of a broader stack and without strong evidence of Go-centered system ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a principal or daily language for backend or service development."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong Go-centered ownership of backend systems or infrastructure over multiple projects."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Positions Go as the core language for designing and implementing production systems highly relevant to the role, especially security or automation backends."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Python experience in production, tooling, or automation contexts relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python experience at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python only vaguely or as an occasional tool, without clear production or automation responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for services, tooling, automation, or prototypes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Python ownership across production code and internal tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major working language for automation or agent layers, with clear production responsibility and breadth."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems experience","description":"How much the letter shows hands-on design or implementation of agentic systems relevant to security automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention building agentic or autonomous tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References agents or autonomous behavior only in passing, with little sense of what the applicant built."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic tooling that combines Python agents with supporting systems at a basic architectural level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly explains the architecture of agentic systems, including the roles of agents and surrounding infrastructure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated agent design for production use, emphasizing bounded autonomy, guardrails, logging, auditability, or similar controls."}]},{"name":"Production AI experience","description":"How much the letter shows real-world experience shipping and operating AI or LLM features.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention AI or model-backed production work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure in generic terms, without clear shipped use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States having built or shipped AI or LLM features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows practical production AI experience with explicit attention to reliability, predictability, or evaluation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates mature production AI judgment by describing both shipped model-based functionality and concrete methods for making it trustworthy under real-world conditions."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How much the letter shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, or handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention automating vulnerability intake, triage, or handling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in security automation but gives no direct example tied to vulnerability work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions having automated vulnerability report intake or triage at a basic level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete vulnerability-handling automation such as classification, routing, deduplication, or queue reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of a vulnerability-handling pipeline and clearly explains how it scaled expert attention or reduced manual workload."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How much hands-on experience the letter shows with security reviews, threat modeling, or similar assessment work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of having performed security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest through mindset, certification, or adjacent work, but does not claim hands-on assessment activity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States having conducted security reviews or assessments of systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Specifies concrete assessment practices such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or remediation verification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows repeated, hands-on assessment work across new designs and existing services, with clear methodological depth and follow-through."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic strength","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no explicit evidence of data structures or algorithms capability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes a generic claim of being comfortable with algorithms, or gives only a vague nod to this area."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports the claim with one concrete example of an algorithmic or data-structure improvement."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Ties strong algorithmic thinking to a substantial redesign of core logic, a hot path, or a previously limiting bottleneck."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes data structures and algorithms feel like an active strength central to solving difficult production problems at scale."}]},{"name":"Independent security development","description":"How much self-driven security skill development beyond core job duties the letter shows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no meaningful evidence of self-driven security skill development outside day-to-day work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a light external signal, such as a basic certification or occasional security practice, with limited demonstrated depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing external security development through regular CTF participation or a credible certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong independent security commitment through serious CTF participation with notable results or a demanding hands-on credential."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-driven security development, with distinguished competition results, a highly rigorous credential, or multiple strong external signals."}]},{"name":"Open-source contribution","description":"How much the letter shows contribution to or maintenance of external open-source software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any open-source contribution or maintenance activity."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions open-source use or interest, but not actual contributions."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or small contributions to external projects."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes regular upstream contribution or maintenance of an actively used project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful open-source ownership, such as maintaining a project with external users or repeatedly fixing and releasing upstream code relied on in practice."}]},{"name":"Self-directed systems building","description":"How much the letter shows technically substantive personal building outside formal job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no personal project, or only a very small side build with little technical challenge described."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a personal project, but the technical ambition or relevance is limited."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a clear personal project that shows initiative and some engineering substance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial systems-oriented project involving distributed systems, storage, recovery, or other nontrivial engineering concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Describes an ambitious self-directed system built specifically to confront hard reliability or distributed-systems problems in depth."}]},{"name":"Evidence-backed specificity","description":"How well the letter supports its claims with concrete, observable examples and outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims about skills or fit, with few concrete examples of what was built or improved."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides some specifics, but many major claims remain unsupported or generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives concrete examples for several key qualifications, though outcomes or mechanics are only moderately detailed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Supports most important claims with specific projects, methods, or results that make the work tangible."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently backs claims with vivid, role-relevant examples that make both the applicant's contribution and the impact easy to picture."}]},{"name":"Organization","description":"How clearly and logically the letter is structured as a case for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a loose collection of points or fragments rather than a coherent case for fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic beginning-to-end structure, but transitions or sequencing are uneven enough to weaken the argument."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is organized clearly enough to follow, with a sensible progression through motivation, background, and fit."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Flows smoothly, with each section reinforcing the next and building a coherent application narrative."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is tightly structured and persuasive, integrating motivation, evidence, and fit into a seamless argument."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the level of spelling, grammar, and professional prose.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or usage errors that noticeably hurt professionalism and readability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains multiple noticeable mechanical errors that distract the reader but do not prevent understanding."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains some mechanical issues, but overall remains reasonably clear and professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Has only minor or rare errors and reads as polished professional prose."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free, with careful wording and strong professional polish throughout."}]}]}
